hero.heading: Find a session
hero.intro: Choose a session that suits your experience and the kind of game you enjoy. New and visiting players are welcome.

partnerNotice.heading: Coming without a partner?
partnerNotice.text: Hosted sessions guarantee a partner. On Wednesday evening, the supervised Starter Session is also open to players without a partner.

items.name: Standard
items.detail: About 3½ hours, at least 24 boards and full green masterpoints.

items.name: Abridged
items.detail: About 3 hours and 20–22 boards, with extra time per round and reduced masterpoints.

items.name: Starter
items.detail: 15–18 boards in a relaxed, supervised game for newer players. Bidding aids are welcome.

hosted.heading: Hosted sessions
hosted.text: A host is provided at these sessions. Singles are paired up, and the host plays if needed.

beforeArrival.heading: Before you arrive
beforeArrival.text: Please be seated 15 minutes before play. Sessions include a 15-minute refreshment break. Fees are $4 for members and $6 for visitors.
